answers.sql: SELECT amount_million FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND period='H1' AND year=2024 AND metric='R&D' UNION ALL SELECT amount_million FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND period='Q2' AND year=2024 AND metric='R&D';

SELECT (q2.amount_million - (h1.amount_million - q2.amount_million)) * 100.0 / (h1.amount_million - q2.amount_million) FROM (SELECT amount_million FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND period='Q2' AND year=2024 AND metric='R&D') q2, (SELECT amount_million FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND period='H1' AND year=2024 AND metric='R&D') h1;
